+SELECT default_role, roles FROM system.users WHERE name = 'default_role_user'
+# Grant explicitly before switching defaults; existing grants are preserved.
+SELECT default_role, roles FROM system.users WHERE name = 'default_role_user'

+SELECT default_role, roles FROM system.users WHERE name = 'default_role_user'
+# Other ALTERs must not silently restore revoked roles.
+SELECT default_role, roles FROM system.users WHERE name = 'default_role_user'
+# Explicitly assigning a dropped role fails even with a stale grant and default.
